commands: printf %b "The jail o-a-apprise has been started successfully." | apprise -c "/etc/fail2ban/apprise.conf"  -t "[Fail2Ban] o-a-apprise: started on `uname -n`"
printf %b "The jail o-a-apprise has been stopped." | apprise -c "/etc/fail2ban/apprise.conf"  -t "[Fail2Ban] o-a-apprise: stopped on `uname -n`"

printf %b "The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against o-a-apprise" | apprise -c "/etc/fail2ban/apprise.conf"  -n "warning" -t "[Fail2Ban] o-a-apprise: banned <ip> from `uname -n`"

files.jail.local:
[o-a-apprise]
enabled = true
filter =
logpath = /dev/null
backend = polling
action = apprise

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING No filter set for jail o-a-apprise
